title: the dwarven deity prose
audit_comment: THE DWARVEN DEITY PROSE - part 1 of the Appendix S description-paragraph pins (the prose alone stays open no more, the dwarves open it). The archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 110-113 reads the five dwarven blocks scan-clean: the Clanggedin fortress and anti-giant methods, the Vergadain con-games and treasure-sensing sword, the Dumathoin veins and earth elementals, the Abbathor greed mechanics and level-draining dagger, the Berronar braid-of-gold and the paladin grant. The stat-block lines stay R406/R783; these paragraphs ride rules/uadeityprose1.h.
include_after: #include "rules/spelltableledger.h"  // R785: the UA spell table ledger
audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
prev_record: - R785 LANDED 2026-10-23: commit
(census 707 -> 708, pushed 9c32b6c..2969a86),
THE UA SPELL TABLE LEDGER - the R342 PDF-ledger
repair (Curtiss's "stay in covered books" call),
sourced from the archive.org full-text OCR of
the continued table. REPAIRED ROSTERS (the
string arrays ride rules/uaspelltables2.h):
6th = 17 (the column reads at last - the twelve
readable cells, Chain Lightning, Ensnarement,
Mordenkainen's Lucubration, Death Spell and
Disintegrate; the loss flag flips), 7th = 16,
8th = 10, 9th = 8 (Succor included - the level
seam-proven by its section heading, equal
evidentiary status with the other UA-new
names). Clone and Otiluke's Telekinetic Sphere
newly read; the contamination repairs re-seat
the drifted cells (Invisible Stalker and the
Tenser/Transmute pair are 6th-column cells);
Glassteel and Power Word Kill DROP to open
holes (absent from the print, the
descriptions, and the registry); the row-number
column contradicts the alphabetical order and
stays unpinned; the "Whip" doubt STRIKES
(uam2WhipName); the illusionist UA-new
censuses pin at 4/4/4/4/2 = 18. THE PINS:
header rules/spelltableledger.h, prefix sld,
13 consts + 20 bools + the 4 x 3 ledger grid
(tag MuLedger), 13 file patches (7 on
uaspelltables2.h, 6 on regtest). TWO SEAM
LESSONS: (a) the R361/R362 audits carry
absent-name loops over the old rosters - a
roster repair MUST reverse them or the build
breaks (grep every accessor user in regtest
before a roster flip); (b) those loops
matched PREFIX strings with strcmp == 0 -
safe while the names were absent, but
reversing to != 0 demands the FULL exact
strings (the first preflight went RED on bad
2: the truncated Mansion string plus the
Invisible Stalker check pointed at 7th idx 1
where Charm Plants sits; two more latent bads
sat in the R362 seam - simulate every patched
strcmp against the emitted arrays before
handoff, the engine cannot catch it: it is
INT-only). rverify GREEN (45 mutants,
0 missed), TWO prefights (RED first pass,
GREEN after the spec fix - restore the tree
before re-running: git checkout the three
patched files + rm the header). NEXT - R786:
awaits Curtiss's call (the UA spell-table
ledger is closed; the noted holes stay
noted, not pinned).

banner.title: THE DWARVEN DEITY PROSE - the Appendix S description paragraphs open: Clanggedin, Vergadain, Dumathoin, Abbathor, and Berronar pin from the clean archive.org OCR read
banner.provenance: The R784 worship-sites round left the per-deity description prose open ("the prose alone stays open"); this is part 1 of the five-part close. The five dwarven blocks (pp. 110-113) read scan-clean in the archive.org full-text OCR: no flagged holes, every pin below is the printed text. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph-level facts pin here - the combat gear bonuses, the special abilities, the worship customs, and the pantheon relationships. The dvpProseStaysOpen pin keeps true (18 paragraphs remain); parts 2-5 cover the elves, halflings, gnomes, and orcs.

consts.name: udpDwarvenDeityCount
consts.comment: The dwarven census: five blocks described (Clanggedin, Vergadain, Dumathoin, Abbathor, Berronar)

consts.name: udpClnGiantAttackToHitMod
consts.comment: Giant-type creatures attack Clanggedin at a -4 penalty to hit, the same as for mortal dwarves

consts.name: udpClnAxeBonus
consts.comment: Clanggedin wields a mithral battle axe +4 in each hand

consts.name: udpClnAxeThrowYards
consts.comment: He can throw the axes with either hand up to 100 yards

consts.name: udpClnChainMailBonus
consts.comment: His armor is steel chain mail +5

consts.name: udpVgdMailBonus
consts.comment: Underneath his suit is a set of golden mail +5

consts.name: udpVgdHeightMinFeet
consts.comment: His necklace changes his height at will, between one foot

consts.name: udpVgdHeightMaxFeet
consts.comment: and 15 feet

consts.name: udpVgdSwordBonus
consts.comment: At his side is a sword +4

consts.name: udpVgdSwordDetectInches
consts.comment: The sword detects all treasures within 2 inches when the hilt is grasped

consts.name: udpDumVeinMetalCount
consts.comment: He lays veins of iron, copper, gold, silver, and mithral - five metals

consts.name: udpDumMinerGemGpValue
consts.comment: Miners carry a small diamond or gemstone (10 gp value) to attract his favor

consts.name: udpDumMattockBonus
consts.comment: He owns a great two-handed mattock +5 of solidified magma

consts.name: udpDumElementalsPerDay
consts.comment: Once per day he may summon earth elementals

consts.name: udpDumElementalsMin
consts.comment: The summoning brings at least 3 elementals

consts.name: udpDumElementalsMax
consts.comment: and at most 18

consts.name: udpDumElementalHitDice
consts.comment: Each elemental has 16 hit dice

consts.name: udpDumEarthSpellLevel
consts.comment: He uses metal-, earth-, or stone-related magic-user spells at the 30th level of ability

consts.name: udpAbbStealTreasureGpLimit
consts.comment: He steals any magical item, or treasure worth more than 1,000 gp

consts.name: udpAbbStealOrSlayPct
consts.comment: A 50 percent chance of either stealing outright or slaying the owner then taking it

consts.name: udpAbbDaggerBonus
consts.comment: He uses a dagger +5 with a diamond blade and jeweled hilt

consts.name: udpAbbDaggerDamageMin
consts.comment: The dagger does a base of 2-24 points of damage: the minimum 2

consts.name: udpAbbDaggerDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 24

consts.name: udpAbbDaggerDetectInches
consts.comment: It detects precious metals (type and amount) in a 2-inch radius

consts.name: udpAbbDaggerLevelLossOnGrasp
consts.comment: Anyone but Abbathor who grasps it loses one experience level at once

consts.name: udpAbbDaggerLevelLossPerRound
consts.comment: and another level each round it is held

consts.name: udpAbbShieldBlindSaveMod
consts.comment: His shield casts one cause blindness spell per round, save at -6

consts.name: udpAbbShieldBlindRangeInches
consts.comment: at any single target within 3 inches

consts.name: udpBerChainMailBonus
consts.comment: She appears a huge dwarf wearing +5 chainmail of bright silver

consts.name: udpBerBraidRowCount
consts.comment: Her brown beard is braided into four rows

consts.name: udpBerBraidRegrowDays
consts.comment: A cut braid regrows in a single day

consts.name: udpBerLockGoldMinGp
consts.comment: The cut lock turns to gold worth 10,000 gp at minimum

consts.name: udpBerLockGoldMaxGp
consts.comment: and at most 40,000 gp

consts.name: udpBerMaceBonus
consts.comment: She wields a +4 mace of gold and steel

consts.name: udpBerMaceSaveMod
consts.comment: It slays evil thieves and all assassins on contact, save versus death magic at -4

consts.name: udpBerTruthRingRadiusInches
consts.comment: One silver ring prevents anyone knowingly telling a falsehood within 10 inches of her

consts.name: udpBerTheftRingSaveMod
consts.comment: The other prevents thieving in the same area unless its user saves versus spell at -2 each round

consts.name: udpBerPaladinChancePct
consts.comment: A lawful good dwarven fighter appeal with a large sacrifice: a 5 percent chance of paladin powers of equal level

consts.name: udpBerPaladinDaysMin
consts.comment: The powers last 3-6 days: the minimum 3

consts.name: udpBerPaladinDaysMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 6

consts.name: udpBerPaladinOncePerYears
consts.comment: The grant may come only once every 10 years to any individual

bools.name: udpClnFortressSouls
bools.comment: Bald and silver-bearded, he lives in a vast mountain fortress manned by the souls of the finest dwarven warriors

bools.name: udpClnTaughtGiantMethods
bools.comment: He taught the dwarves many special methods of combating giant-types

bools.name: udpClnPassedSkillsToGnomes
bools.comment: and passed his knowledge and skills on to the gnomish gods as well

bools.name: udpClnHatesGrolantor
bools.comment: His most hated enemies are Grolantor the hill giant god and that deity's followers

bools.name: udpClnSingsInBattle
bools.comment: In the heat of battle he is fond of singing, unnerving opponents and increasing his followers' morale

bools.name: udpClnThrownAxesStrikeAsHand
bools.comment: His thrown axes do damage as if he had struck the target by hand, with all appropriate bonuses

bools.name: udpClnSpellsIndirectOnly
bools.comment: He usually uses his magical spell ability only to indirectly affect the course of events

bools.name: udpClnAvoidsSpellsInMelee
bools.comment: He resorts to spells or spell devices in close combat only when his Prime Material existence is at stake

bools.name: udpVgdMerchantsPatron
bools.comment: The patron god of dwarven merchants

bools.name: udpVgdNonevilThievesPatron
bools.comment: and of most non-evil dwarven thieves is the scheming Vergadain

bools.name: udpVgdPoetClueVerses
bools.comment: A great poet, he dispenses treasure-location clues hidden in a verse or rhyme

bools.name: udpVgdEvaluatesTreasure
bools.comment: His bard-like talents give him the ability to carefully evaluate treasures as to their true nature and worth

bools.name: udpVgdBrownAndYellow
bools.comment: He appears a huge dwarf wearing brown and yellow clothing

bools.name: udpVgdConGames
bools.comment: His adventures concern elaborate con games played on human, demi-human, humanoid, and giant victims

bools.name: udpVgdSuspiciousFollowers
bools.comment: His followers are usually seen as suspicious characters; few dwarves will willingly admit worshiping him

bools.name: udpVgdDenialNotOffensive
bools.comment: A follower's denial of the deity does not offend him, so long as the proper sacrifices are made

bools.name: udpDumHidesSecrets
bools.comment: He hides the secrets of the earth until they are ready to be uncovered by the diligent and the deserving

bools.name: udpDumProtectorOfMountainDwarves
bools.comment: He is the protector of the mountain dwarves

bools.name: udpDumKeeperOfMetals
bools.comment: the keeper of all metals

bools.name: udpDumNeverSpeaks
bools.comment: He has never been known to speak, keeping his wisdom to himself, though he may send subtle clues to keen observers

bools.name: udpDumMoradinNamed
bools.comment: Moradin named him protector of the mountain dwarves

bools.name: udpDumParadiseForDwarves
bools.comment: He created a paradise for the mountain dwarves to enjoy

bools.name: udpDumPleasedByCraftsmanship
bools.comment: Angered when the dwarves destroyed the mountains, his anger turned to pleasure at the finely crafted metal items they produced

bools.name: udpDumHatesPlunderers
bools.comment: His enemies are those who plunder the earth's riches for unfair or selfish purposes

bools.name: udpDumAllowsMining
bools.comment: He does not object to tunneling, mining, or the keeping of treasures underground

bools.name: udpDumGrayStoneHair
bools.comment: He appears a gigantic dwarven figure with hair and beard of gray stone

bools.name: udpDumEarthBrownSkin
bools.comment: earth-brown skin

bools.name: udpDumSilverFireEyes
bools.comment: and eyes of silver fire

bools.name: udpDumElementalsFightToDeath
bools.comment: The summoned elementals fight for him to the death, instantly, at will

bools.name: udpDumEarthSpellsOnly
bools.comment: He may use only metal-, earth-, or stone-related magic-user spells, no others

bools.name: udpDumFriendlyToNonDwarves
bools.comment: Unlike most dwarven deities he maintains friendly relations with non-dwarven deities, though only a few

bools.name: udpDumHephaestusAlly
bools.comment: One of his closest allies is Hephaestus, whom he supplies with adamantite ore

bools.name: udpAbbTreacherousAlly
bools.comment: At times an ally of the other dwarven gods, his treachery and lust for treasure make him a dangerous associate

bools.name: udpAbbNeverHelpsNonDwarves
bools.comment: He will never help any non-dwarven deity or creature

bools.name: udpAbbOriginallyAppreciation
bools.comment: Originally his sphere was the appreciation of valuable gems and metals, not necessarily at others' expense

bools.name: udpAbbEmbitteredByChoice
bools.comment: He became embittered when Moradin appointed Dumathoin protector of the mountain dwarves instead of him

bools.name: udpAbbGoldenCaverns
bools.comment: His home caverns are said to be made of purest gold - fact or legend

bools.name: udpAbbSlayOrSteal
bools.comment: On seeing any magical item or treasure over the limit he attempts to steal it outright or slay the owner and take it

bools.name: udpAbbWearsFurs
bools.comment: He wears leather armor and furs made from the skins of beings who opposed him

bools.name: udpAbbDaggerDiamondBlade
bools.comment: His dagger has a diamond blade and jewels set into the hilt

bools.name: udpAbbDaggerDetectsMetals
bools.comment: The dagger detects the presence of precious metals, type and amount

bools.name: udpAbbDaggerDrainsGraspers
bools.comment: Anyone but Abbathor who grasps the weapon suffers experience-level loss

bools.name: udpAbbShieldBlinds
bools.comment: His shield casts one cause blindness spell per round at a single target at a time

bools.name: udpAbbTruceWithVergadain
bools.comment: He maintains an uneasy truce with Vergadain, with whom he sometimes roams the Prime Material for treasure

bools.name: udpAbbDestroysIfFrustrated
bools.comment: If frustrated when attempting to steal an item he will try to destroy it

bools.name: udpBerGreatestGoddess
bools.comment: The greatest of all dwarven goddesses is usually held to be Berronar

bools.name: udpBerLivesAtSoulForge
bools.comment: She lives with Moradin in the Seven Heavens at the Soul Forge beneath the mountains

bools.name: udpBerPatronessOfMarriage
bools.comment: She is the patroness of marriage and love, but not necessarily romance

bools.name: udpBerInvokedAgainstThieves
bools.comment: Her name is invoked in small home rituals for protection from thieves and duplicity

bools.name: udpBerLockTurnsToGold
bools.comment: At the end of the day a cut lock of her hair turns to gold

bools.name: udpBerGivesLocksToPoor
bools.comment: She sometimes gives locks of her hair to dwarven communities that are exceptionally poor or hard-pressed

bools.name: udpBerLockNeedsTopCleric
bools.comment: The gift must be invoked by a lawful good dwarven cleric of the highest level in the colony, and is extremely rare

bools.name: udpBerGoldVanishesIfMisused
bools.comment: If this gold or any part of it is used for other than good purposes it will all disappear

bools.name: udpBerMaceSlaysEvilThieves
bools.comment: Her mace slays evil thieves and all assassins on contact

bools.name: udpBerRingTruth
bools.comment: One of her two silver rings of great power prevents anyone from knowingly telling a falsehood within its radius

bools.name: udpBerRingTheft
bools.comment: The other prevents the use of thieving abilities by mortals in the same area, unless they save versus spell each round of use

bools.name: udpBerInspiredRingCustom
bools.comment: She is said to have inspired the dwarven custom of exchanging rings for exceptional mutual trust and love

bools.name: udpBerRingCustomLawfulGood
bools.comment: The ceremony is almost never undertaken with a non-dwarf, and both participants must be lawful good

bools.name: udpBerGrantsPaladinPowers
bools.comment: She may bestow the powers of a paladin of equal level upon a lawful good dwarven fighter who appeals with an appropriately large sacrifice

bools.name: udpBerPureHeartOnly
bools.comment: Only dwarves of exceptionally pure heart are considered for the paladin grant
